decision.rationale: Use the lower-cost exact nano snapshot for routine structured advisory classification while reserving exact full GPT-5.4 for at most 12 potentially decision-changing source-truth cases; deterministic scoring remains authoritative.
limitations: This is network-free build evidence, not product-quality evidence.
All three configurations use one provider family and model-assisted review is not independent human annotation.
No paid, private-data, final 10,000-case, T1, fidelity, promotion, or deployment execution occurred.
